messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
How do I reset my Common App password if I forgot it?

Use the “Forgot your password?” link on the Common App sign-in page, then follow the reset link sent to your email. If the email doesn’t arrive, check spam/junk and any school email filters, then try again.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
I can’t log in even with the right password—what should I try first?

First, confirm you’re using the correct email/username for your account. Then try a different browser, clear cache/cookies, disable extensions (especially ad blockers), and try an incognito/private window.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I change the email address tied to my Common App account?

Yes. In your Common App account settings, use the option to change your email address. Make sure you can access the new email because Common App will send verification and submission notifications there.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What should I do if I no longer have access to the email I used for Common App?
Try to regain access to that email first (password recovery). If that’s not possible, use Common App support to verify your identity and help you update the account email safely.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Why am I not receiving Common App emails (verification, recommender invites, etc.)?
Check spam/junk and search your inbox for 'Common App'. If you use a school email, ask IT to whitelist Common App emails. Also confirm you typed the email correctly and that your mailbox isn’t full.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I have more than one Common App account?

It’s strongly discouraged. Multiple accounts can cause missing documents, duplicate recommender uploads, or submission confusion. Use one account per application type and contact support if you accidentally created an extra one.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
I accidentally created a transfer account but I’m a first-year applicant (or vice versa). What now?

Sign in to the account you created, then follow Common App guidance to switch to the correct application type—often by updating your account email on one account so you can create/use the correct account cleanly.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
How do I change my name or date of birth if I entered it incorrectly?
Minor profile fields can often be edited directly in the Profile section. For identity fields that are locked or affect submissions, contact Common App support and follow their verification process.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
How do I update my phone number or address after I submitted to some colleges?

Update it in the Profile section for future submissions. For colleges already submitted, also update through the college’s applicant portal or email admissions, because submitted applications may not auto-update.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
My Common App page keeps logging me out. How can I reduce that?
Avoid multiple tabs, disable auto-refresh extensions, and save frequently. If it persists, clear cookies and try a different browser or device.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Is it safe to work on Common App using a public computer?
It’s possible, but log out completely, avoid saving passwords, and don’t upload sensitive documents on shared devices if you can avoid it. Use private browsing and clear downloads afterward.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What browser works best for Common App?
A current version of Chrome or Firefox is usually the most reliable. If something breaks, try another browser, disable extensions, and clear cache/cookies.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Does Common App have an app for iPhone/Android?
Common App is primarily web-based. While mobile browsers may work for reading or minor edits, it’s safer to do submissions and uploads on a computer.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
How do I contact Common App support, and what information should I include?
Use the official support contact form. Include your full name, date of birth, the email on your account, and a clear description of the issue (plus screenshots if relevant).
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I delete my Common App account?

Yes, but do it carefully. If you have already submitted applications, deleting the account may not undo what colleges already received. If your goal is to correct information, contacting the colleges is usually better.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What is 'account rollover' in Common App?
Account rollover is Common App’s annual refresh for a new application cycle (typically around August 1). You keep your login, and some information carries over into the new cycle.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
When does the Common App cycle refresh each year?
Common App typically launches the new application cycle around August 1 each year. Plan ahead if you’re working near the end of July.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What information usually carries over after rollover?
Many ‘common’ sections (Profile, Family, Education, Testing, Activities, Writing, and Courses & Grades) often carry over, along with your college list and some advisor invitations.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What information does NOT carry over after rollover?
College-specific questions (My Colleges responses), FERPA release authorizations, and recommender invitations often do not carry over, so expect to re-do those in the new cycle.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Will my Common App personal essay carry over after rollover?
Your Writing section content often carries over, but you should still copy your essays into a backup document before rollover, just in case prompts or fields change.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Will my Activities list carry over after rollover?
Activities commonly carry over, but you should keep a backup copy and re-check everything after rollover for completeness and formatting.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Do counselor/teacher invitations carry over after rollover?
Recommender invitations often do NOT carry over; plan to re-invite recommenders in the new cycle if needed.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Do the colleges on my list stay on my Dashboard after rollover?
Your college list often carries over, but the college-specific questions and requirements can change. Re-check each college’s tabs after rollover.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
I worked on supplements before rollover—will I lose them?
College-specific responses often do not carry over. Before rollover, copy supplemental answers to a separate document so you can paste them back later.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
How do I know I’m editing the correct (current) application cycle?
After you sign in, check the application year shown on the dashboard and confirm the start term and deadlines for each college match the current cycle.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
If I start my application early, will colleges see my drafts?
No. Colleges only see what you submit. Drafts are visible only to you until you submit to a specific college.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What should I do the week before rollover to avoid losing work?
Export or copy your essays, supplements, and any long text answers to a backup file, and keep a list of your colleges and deadlines so you can restore quickly after rollover.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Why do some questions disappear after rollover?
Some questions are edited, removed, or moved each year. If you don’t see a question anymore, check the current cycle’s requirements for that college or section.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
How many colleges can I add in Common App?
Common App limits students to adding up to 20 colleges on their Dashboard/My Colleges list for a given account/cycle.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I remove a college from My Colleges after I submit to it?
Typically no—once you submit an application to a college, Common App often prevents removing that college from your My Colleges list.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What if I hit the 20-college limit but still want to apply to more schools?
Use another application platform accepted by those schools (e.g., Coalition, institutional applications). The 20-college limit is not usually expandable.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
If I remove a college before submitting, will it delete my supplemental answers?
Yes, removing a college can erase college-specific work for that school. Before removing, copy your supplemental responses to a separate document.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I temporarily remove a school and add it back later?
You can often add it back, but your college-specific answers may not be preserved. Treat removal as a reset for that school’s My Colleges questions.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Why can’t I find a college in the Common App search?
Some colleges may not be active in Common App for your application type (first-year vs transfer) or start term. Confirm the college participates in Common App for your intended cycle/term.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Why does one college show different requirements than another?
Each college configures its own supplemental questions, required documents, and recommendation limits. Always follow the college-specific checklist in My Colleges.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What is the difference between the Common App tab and the My Colleges tab?
The Common App tab contains shared information used across colleges. The My Colleges tab contains college-specific questions, recommender assignments, and submission checklists.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Does adding a college notify the college that I’m interested?

Adding a college mostly helps you organize your application. Some colleges may receive limited interest signals only if you also opt into communications; when in doubt, assume adding alone is not a formal expression of interest.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
How do I change a college’s start term (Fall vs Spring) after adding it?

Open that college in My Colleges and look for start term/entry term fields. If you can’t change it, remove the college (before submitting) and add it again with the correct term—after saving your text elsewhere.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Why does my Dashboard show 'incomplete' even though I filled the Common App sections?
Dashboard completeness also depends on college-specific items (supplements, fee/payment, recommenders). Open the college checklist to see what’s still missing.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
How do I sort or track colleges by deadline in Common App?
Use the Dashboard views and each college’s deadline fields, but also maintain a separate spreadsheet/calendar. Deadlines can differ by decision plan (ED/EA/RD).
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I apply to the same college for two different start terms from one account?
Usually you submit one application per college per cycle and start term. If you need a different term, check the college’s instructions or contact admissions.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
If a college leaves Common App mid-cycle, what happens?
Your existing draft may remain, but submission paths can change. Follow the college’s official admissions site and contact their admissions office for alternate submission instructions.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What does 'inactive' or 'not available' mean for a college in Common App?
It may mean the college is not accepting applications for your selected term or application type, or the deadline window has closed.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Why can’t I submit my application even though everything looks done?

A common cause is selecting a start term or decision plan that is not currently available for that college. Double-check those fields in My Colleges, then revisit the Review & Submit page for missing items.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What does 'Review and Submit' actually do?
It runs a final completeness check for that specific college (including supplements, questions, and required fields), then routes you to payment/fee waiver and the final submission confirmation.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
How do I confirm my application is actually submitted?
Look for a confirmation screen and an email receipt/confirmation. Your Dashboard status for that college should show it was submitted; if it only shows 'paid,' you may need to finish the submit step.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
If I submit at 11:59 PM, whose time zone counts?
Deadlines typically follow the college’s stated deadline policy (often local time or a specified time zone). Don’t gamble—submit at least a day early when possible.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
My application is due today and Common App is slow. What should I do?

Switch browsers, try incognito, disable extensions, and avoid repeated refresh loops. If the site is down, document the issue with screenshots and contact the college admissions office as soon as possible.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I submit without my counselor sending the School Report yet?
Often yes—your portion can be submitted first—but some colleges won’t review the file until counselor documents arrive. Confirm each college’s document requirements and timelines.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I submit without teacher recommendations uploaded yet?
Often yes—recommendations can arrive later—but some colleges have internal deadlines for recommenders. Communicate deadlines clearly to your teachers.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I submit my application from a phone?
You may be able to, but it’s risky for uploads and payment. For final submission, use a computer and stable internet if possible.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What should I do if the final submit button doesn’t work?
Try a different browser, clear cache/cookies, disable extensions, and try a private window. If it still fails, try another device/network and contact support.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Does Common App autosave my work?
Many fields autosave, but don’t rely on it. After major edits, navigate to another page/section to trigger save, and keep a backup of long text responses.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What happens if I miss a deadline by a few minutes?
That depends on the college. Some systems close strictly; others may be flexible. Contact the college admissions office immediately and be honest.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
How do I submit Early Decision vs Regular Decision in Common App?
Choose the correct decision plan for each college (ED/EA/RD) in that college’s My Colleges section, then confirm the deadline displayed matches your plan before submitting.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I change my decision plan after submitting (e.g., ED to RD)?
Not within Common App for a submitted application. Contact the college admissions office to ask if and how they can change your plan.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What is the 'college-specific deadline' field used for?
It helps Common App and the college apply the correct application routing and required questions. Always pick the option that matches the college’s admissions website.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Why does Common App show a different deadline than the college website?
College websites are the source of truth. If you see a mismatch, follow the college website and notify the college or Common App support about the discrepancy.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I submit the Common App essay and supplements separately?
No. Submission happens per college and includes your Common App sections plus that college’s required items at the time you submit.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What does it mean when a college status says 'downloaded' by the college?
It generally means the college has retrieved your application file from Common App. It does not guarantee your file is complete—check your portal for document status.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Should I submit earlier even if my essays aren’t perfect yet?
Submitting early reduces technical risk, but only submit when your content is ready. Aim to finalize content, then submit at least several days before the deadline.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Where do I invite my teacher recommenders in Common App?
Open a specific college under My Colleges, go to Recommenders & FERPA, then add the teacher’s name and email in the Teacher Recommenders section.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What does it mean to 'assign' a recommender?
Assigning links a recommender to a specific college so their letter can be sent there. Adding a recommender without assigning them may not trigger a submission workflow for that college.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
My teacher didn’t receive the invitation email—what should I check?
Confirm the email address is correct, ask them to check spam/junk, and ensure you assigned them to at least one college. Then use the resend option if available.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
How do I resend a recommender invitation?
Go to that college’s Recommenders & FERPA page, find the recommender in your list, and use the resend option (often an icon/button next to their name).
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I use different teacher recommenders for different colleges?
Yes. Recommender assignment is per college. You can assign Teacher A to College 1 and Teacher B to College 2 as needed.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
If my teacher uploads one letter, do they have to upload again for each college?
Usually the same letter can be routed to multiple colleges you assign, but some colleges may request different letters or forms. Check each college’s recommender requirements.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What is the FERPA waiver in Common App?
FERPA waiver asks whether you waive your right to view recommendation letters. Many colleges view waived letters as more candid; choose carefully and consistently.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Does waiving FERPA change what colleges receive?
Colleges still receive recommendations either way, but waiver status can affect how the letters are perceived and whether you can later request to view them through your school.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I un-invite a recommender after I sent an invite?
You may be able to remove or replace a recommender before they submit. If they already submitted, replacement rules vary—contact the college or your counselor if you need to correct something.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
I entered the wrong recommender email. What should I do?
If they haven’t submitted, remove that recommender entry and invite them again with the correct email. If they already submitted under the wrong email, contact Common App support for guidance.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
How many teacher recommendations can I send through Common App?
The allowed number is set by each college. Some accept 1, some 2, some more. Follow the college’s recommender limits shown in My Colleges.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What is an 'Other Recommender' and when should I use it?
It’s for recommenders who aren’t teachers or counselors (e.g., coach, employer, mentor). Use it only if the college accepts/requests an additional letter type.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can a coach or research mentor submit a recommendation through Common App?
Yes, if the college supports 'Other Recommender' or similar. Invite them under the appropriate recommender type and assign them to the colleges that accept it.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
My counselor wants to upload my School Report—do I need to invite them?
Yes, you typically add your counselor in the counselor/advisor section, which starts the school-side workflow for reports and transcripts.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I see whether my recommender has submitted?
Common App usually shows status indicators (invited/started/submitted) in the Recommenders section for each college. You can also ask the recommender directly.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Do recommenders see my whole application?
They typically see only what’s necessary to submit their letter and forms, not your full application content. Policies vary by school/counselor platform.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
If I apply to the same college via Common App and Coalition, can I reuse the same recommender letters?
Not automatically. Recommenders usually must submit within each platform unless your school uses a separate system to send documents. Ask your counselor about your school’s process.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can my recommender upload a letter after the college deadline?
Sometimes colleges allow a short grace period for supporting documents, but not always. Ask your recommender to submit early and check each college’s document deadline policy.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
How do I handle a recommender who is unfamiliar with Common App?
Send them a short checklist: invitation email, account creation, upload letter, submit forms, confirm 'submitted' status. Offer to test the link and help with spam filters.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
My recommender says the link expired or doesn’t work. What now?
Resend the invite, ask them to try a different browser, and ensure they use the exact email you invited. If it still fails, contact Common App support.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I submit my application before the recommender accepts the invite?
Often yes, but the college may not consider your file complete until recommendations are received. Submit your portion when ready and keep tracking docs in the portal.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Why do I see 'optional' next to a recommender request? Should I still send one?
Optional means the college doesn’t require it, but an additional strong letter can help. Only send extra letters if they add real value and the college accepts them.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I send more recommendation letters than the college requests?
Usually no—Common App enforces the college’s set limits. If a college allows extras through their portal, follow their instructions instead of Common App.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I change the type of an 'Other Recommender' after inviting them?
Sometimes the type is locked once created. If you need to change it, you may have to remove and re-invite them under the correct type, or request help from Common App support.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What is the School Report?
It’s a counselor form that provides context about your school (profile, grading, curriculum) and confirms your academic record via transcript submission.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What is the Midyear Report and who sends it?
It’s usually sent by your counselor after midyear grades are available. Some colleges require it; others don’t. Check each college’s document requirements.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What is the Final Report?
It’s sent after you graduate and confirms final grades and graduation status. Many colleges require it if you enroll.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I submit my application before my transcript is uploaded?
Often yes, but your application may be incomplete until the transcript arrives. Coordinate with your counselor and monitor your portal checklist.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
My counselor is new to Common App. How can I help them?
Share the Common App counselor guide link from your school, confirm the counselor email is correct, and provide a list of your colleges and deadlines so they can submit reports on time.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
I attended more than one high school. How do I report that?
Add each high school you attended in the Education section and follow Common App instructions for how to report transcripts/courses across schools.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
My transcript isn’t ready yet. Should I wait to submit?
If a college requires self-reported Courses & Grades, waiting may be necessary. If it doesn’t, you can often submit your portion while the counselor sends the transcript later.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
How do I check whether my counselor documents were received by the college?
Use the college’s applicant portal checklist (best source) and compare it with Common App’s status indicators. Portals are typically more detailed.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What if my counselor submitted the wrong transcript?
Ask your counselor to contact the college directly and send the correct transcript per the college’s preferred method. Document corrections are usually handled by the school/college.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can homeschool applicants use Common App counselor forms?
Yes, but homeschool setups vary. The parent/guardian may act as counselor depending on Common App and college policies. Follow the homeschool instructions provided in Common App and by each college.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
My school uses a third-party transcript service. How does that work with Common App?
Many schools integrate transcripts through counselor accounts or third-party services. Ask your counseling office which method they use and how you should request transcripts.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Do counselors have to submit separate forms for every college?
Often the counselor forms are shared across colleges on your list, but some colleges require additional items. Your counselor should verify the document list per college.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What if my counselor misses a document deadline?
Contact the college admissions office immediately. Some colleges allow late supporting docs; others don’t. Provide proof you submitted your portion on time if applicable.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I upload my own transcript instead of my counselor?
Most colleges prefer official transcripts submitted by the school. If a college allows self-upload, it will usually be via the college portal; follow that college’s instructions.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
How do I handle a counselor change mid-year?
Update the counselor information if needed and ensure the new counselor can access your Common App school account workflow. Notify colleges if there’s a reporting delay.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
My counselor says they can’t see one of my colleges. Why?

The college might not be assigned properly, you may not have completed FERPA steps for that college, or the college may not be eligible in the cycle/term. Review your My Colleges setup and counselor invitation status.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
How do I request a fee waiver in Common App?
In your Profile section, find the Common App fee waiver questions and indicate eligibility. Then follow prompts; your counselor may be asked to confirm.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
If I select a fee waiver, do all colleges automatically waive their fees?
Not always. Some colleges accept the Common App fee waiver; others have separate or additional policies. Check each college’s fee waiver rules.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
My counselor hasn’t confirmed my fee waiver yet. Can I still submit?
In many cases you can submit while it’s pending, but rules can vary by college/system state. If blocked, ask your counselor to confirm promptly.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Why does my application say 'Payment Issue' after I tried to submit?

It usually means the payment didn’t finalize correctly or the submission didn’t complete after payment. Re-check the college’s Review & Submit flow, and follow any prompts to retry or contact support.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
I paid the application fee, but the application still shows 'not submitted.' What should I do?
Return to that college’s Review & Submit page and confirm the final submission step completed. If it still doesn’t change, contact Common App support and keep your payment receipt.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What is 'Payment in Progress' and how do I fix it?
It can happen during busy periods or if your browser/session glitches. Try clearing cache, restarting the browser/computer, and submitting again using a different browser or network.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I pay for multiple colleges at once?
Fees are typically processed per college submission. You’ll go through payment during each college’s submission flow unless a specific workflow groups them.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I use an international credit card to pay?
Often yes, but card acceptance can vary. If payment fails, try another card, ensure international transactions are enabled, or use an alternate payment method if offered.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Will I get a receipt for my application fee?
You should receive an email confirmation/receipt after payment. Save it as proof, especially if your submission status looks wrong.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What if my bank flags the payment as fraud?
Authorize the transaction with your bank, then retry payment. Use a stable network and avoid multiple repeated attempts in a short time.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Can I get a refund if I withdraw an application?
Refund policies vary and are usually strict. Many application fees are nonrefundable once processed. Check the college’s policy and the payment terms shown at checkout.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
What should I do if the fee waiver question doesn’t appear in my Profile?
It may be hidden if you selected a certain applicant type or if the system is in a specific state. Re-check the Profile section and search the Help Center; if still missing, contact support.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
Why does one college charge a fee and another does not?
Application fees are set by each college. Some have no fee, some waive fees broadly, and some charge different amounts depending on program.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
If I apply to a fee-free college, do I still see payment screens?
You may still go through a submission confirmation flow, but it should reflect $0 due. If it asks for payment anyway, double-check the college’s fee settings in Common App.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
If a college is test-optional, should I enter my test scores anyway?
Only if you want the college to consider them and the college allows self-reporting via Common App. If you’re unsure, review that college’s test policy and instructions.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
If I enter test scores in Common App, will all colleges see them?
Colleges typically receive what you submit to them, but how scores are used depends on the college’s policy and any college-specific questions. When test-optional, confirm per-college settings.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
How do I report multiple SAT/ACT dates?
Enter each test date separately with its scores. If the college superscores, they will typically combine your best section scores across dates according to their policy.
You are a helpful assistant that answers questions about using Common App for college applications.
How do I report superscores if Common App doesn’t have a superscore field?
List each test sitting as its own entry. Superscoring is usually applied by colleges during review rather than by the Common App form itself.
